visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and a white t-shirt stands indoors. He speaks toward the camera with an expressive face and squinted eyes. Behind him is a brightly lit room featuring a mirror reflecting the back of his head and shelves. (2) The man lifts a large, matte grey rectangular box into the frame, holding it with both hands. The box has a slightly reflective surface. The background remains the same indoor setting with soft, warm overhead lighting. (3) The man places the box on a light-colored wooden table and opens it, revealing layers of black protective foam. His hands move precisely as he removes the top layer of foam to reveal a black envelope and a heavy base plate. (4) Close-up of a black information card with white text listing various car models like Roadster, Model S, and Model X. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the texture of the card and the printed specifications. (5) The man holds a heavy, curved black base plate made of metal and suede. He points to the indented names of Tesla models on the surface. His gold ring is visible on his finger as he gestures towards the plate. (6) A handheld shot shows the man tapping a small black lavalier microphone against the metal base plate. The camera focus is tight on the contact point between the mic and the plate on the wooden table. (7) Macro shots of the base plate show the years 2008, 2012, 2015, and 2017 printed alongside car model names. The camera pans across the curved edge of the display stand to show the detailed engraving and material quality. (8) The man lifts another foam layer to reveal seven matte gold-colored car models nestled in individual compartments. The cars have smooth, aerodynamic shapes. He looks down at them with a wide smile and high energy. (9) Individual close-ups follow for each car model: the Roadster, Model S, Model X with open falcon doors, Model 3, Model Y, the Semi truck, and the Cybertruck. Each car is held close to the lens. (10) The man carefully places the gold cars onto the black base plate. The finished assembly shows all seven cars arranged chronologically on the curved stand. He holds the entire display up toward the camera, grinning widely. (11) A final screen appears with a white and black background featuring a large QR code in the center. Chinese text is visible at the bottom of the screen. Animated glowing outlines briefly appear around the man in the previous shot.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice speaking enthusiastically over a rapid digital clicking sound, similar to a keyboard. A steady, mid-tempo electronic BGM starts in the background. (2) A sharp rustling and sliding sound occurs as cardboard surfaces rub against each other, indicating the box is being opened. The male speaker continues his fast-paced narration. (3) A distinct crinkling sound of plastic and foam is heard as layers are removed. The BGM maintains a consistent beat, while the vocal tone remains high-pitched and energized. (4) A heavy, muffled thud sounds as a dense metal object is placed onto a wooden surface. The speaker's volume increases slightly to emphasize the weight of the item. (5) Three sharp, clear metallic 'ping' sounds are heard as a microphone taps against a metal plate. These transients are bright and have short decay times. (6) More rapid digital clicking SFX are layered over the speech as dates are shown on screen. The BGM provides a stable rhythmic floor underneath the narration. (7) High-frequency rustling of foam occurs again as the car models are unveiled. The male voice exhibits a laughing, joyful tone with high emotional valence. (8) A series of small, rhythmic metallic clinks occur as individual die-cast models are handled. Each sound is crisp and well-defined within the mix. (9) The sequence of metallic clicks continues as the cars are placed onto the stand. The BGM swells slightly in volume during this montage segment. (10) A female voice laughs briefly in the background during the final conclusion. A synthetic 'whoosh' transition sound marks the end of the main review. (11) The audio concludes with a final melodic chime and a quick fade-out of the electronic music as the QR code appears.
